Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Class MergingUndoManager

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.undo.AbstractUndoableEdit
javax.swing.undo.CompoundEdit
javax.swing.undo.UndoManager
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.MergingUndoManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, EventListener, UndoableEditListener, UndoableEdit
public class MergingUndoManager extends UndoManager
The editor's undo stack: a bounded UndoManager that merges a burst of single-character typing into one undo step, so Ctrl+Z removes the word you just typed rather than one letter at a time, while every other edit (paste, replace-all, delete, programmatic insert) stays atomic on its own.

Merging rule: consecutive single-character INSERT edits at contiguous offsets, each arriving within MERGE_WINDOW_MS of the previous one, are folded into a CompoundEdit. Anything else — a pause, a caret jump, a multi-character insert — closes the burst. The time window is injectable so tests run deterministically without sleeping.
